envelope.description: Add AnalyzeRequest, the two intent fields and the RPC parser support

body.title: Add AnalyzeRequest, the two intent fields and the RPC parser support
body.summary: Add AnalyzeRequest to src/shared/analyze-types.ts; add optional context and scopeSource (explicit | undefined) to ClassifiedIntent and UnsizedIntent; make parseIntent in src/daemon/analyze-rpc.ts keep context (string, at most 4000 characters) and scopeSource ('request' or 'prompt') and refuse any other value; an intent without them parses as before.
acceptanceChecks: parseIntent keeps context and scopeSource and refuses a bad value of either
an intent without the fields parses exactly as before

tests.name: analyze-rpc-intent.test.ts: parseIntent keeps context and scopeSource, refuses a bad value of either, and parses an intent without them as before
